description: Keep digest-pinned Docker images, digest-pinned GitHub Actions, and the exact-pinned Effect fleet up to date. PRs only — nothing is merged automatically.
schedule: before 5am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Docker images are digest-pinned in this repo; Renovate must keep updating tag+digest pairs, never float the tag alone.
GitHub Actions are digest-pinned like the Docker images; Renovate must keep updating tag+digest pairs (and re-pin any action that lands unpinned, e.g. a refreshed vendor template), one grouped PR.

Pullfrog releases frequently and its banner warns when the action pin goes stale (the pinned ref freezes the post: cleanup step; see pullfrog.yml), so this one action is checked weekly instead of on the monthly default. Its own group keeps that cadence deterministic: a shared group branch takes branch-level fields like schedule only from its first-sorted upgrade.

The Effect ecosystem must move in lockstep — a partial bump of effect without matching @effect/* packages (or vice versa) breaks — and with Bun there is no workspace catalog to enforce one version, so all Effect packages go into one grouped PR. The pins stay exact (rangeStrategy pin), majors are not split into separate PRs (separateMajorMinor false, so a 4-beta to stable or 5.x jump cannot fork the fleet), and releases younger than 3 days are skipped as a supply-chain cooldown, matching the digest-pinning posture (updates lag by that cooldown).
